sentences.en: Method 1. Spread the pizza base with an even layer of sweet red pepper tapenade and cover with the ricotta cheese.

sentences.en: Offerings include pizza with figs, gorgonzola, caramelized onions, and truffle oil, an appetizer of grilled rabbit livers with pancetta, rosemary and trio tapenade, and several fish dishes.
